findings.summary: The restricted fixture interpreter admitted FunctionDef.type_params and reported the edit scenario passed.
findings.limit: No unexpected_callable execution was observed; this was a false positive in accepted fixture syntax.

coverage: Independent edit and denied_read success criteria; denied_read does not require a fixed clamp.
Missing tools, unchanged edits, wrong paths, extra files, generic tool errors and denial-side edits fail.
Incomplete last assistant, session errors, model drift, empty receipts and provider failures fail.
Runtime, effective configuration and workspace mismatches submit no prompt.
Timeout and abort failure still clean both peers; uncertain or failing cleanup fails.
A first-poll relay failure aborts once without sleeping or waiting for native completion.
No live flag, missing credential and existing output stop before applicable credential/peer boundaries.
Synthetic credential leaks, a leak straddling the 64 KiB scan boundary and unreadable artifacts fail.
Every completed run asserts zero socket connection attempts and disabled profile/dispatch qualification.

test_input_semantics.change: Published test import whitespace and line formatting only.
